WITH ev AS (
  SELECT e.event_id,
         e.location,
         AVG((b.spent - b.amount) / b.amount) AS avg_ratio
  FROM event e
  JOIN budget b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
  GROUP BY e.event_id, e.location
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT event_id,
         location,
         avg_ratio,
         RANK() OVER (
           PARTITION BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(location), ''), '')
           ORDER BY (avg_ratio IS NULL), avg_ratio DESC
         ) AS rnk
  FROM ev
)
SELECT event_id, location, avg_ratio, rnk
FROM ranked
WHERE rnk <= 3
ORDER BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(location), ''), ''), rnk, event_id
